metadata.description: ow-tools only: the code add-on for the ow- planning skills in Claude Code. Approving this marketplace approves ow-tools and nothing else.

plugins.name: ow-tools
plugins.description: Runs code on your machine: local transcription with speaker separation, branded and accessible PDF, Word and PowerPoint export, Excel with formulas, test-environment screenshots, read-only health checks, a redacted secrets scan of a repository's committed history, digests, date arithmetic (with the US federal contract calendar) and hours arithmetic, and a session-start list of open ow- workstreams. Audio never leaves the machine; only health and capture use the network.
